examples: 'kumBapAtamAtragatajIvitaM taM nakulaM tatrEvAvagaRayya' (paYcata0). sAvahelaM tatrEva vihAyetyarTaH.
'tato BUyo vyagaRayat svabudDyA munisattamaH' (BA0 Salya0 50.61). vyacArayadityarTaH.

'kimapi vigaRayanto budDimantaH sahante' (paYcata0 3.40). kimapi cintayanta ityarTa iti vayam. avajAnanta iti saMskftaSArmaRyakozaH. asmadukta evArTaH sADuritImA udAhftayo BUyassamarTayante--adUravartinIM sidDiM rAjan vigaRayAtmanaH (raGu0 1.87).
'ko vIryARyADigaRayet sahasrajihnaH' (BA0 pu0 5.25.12). aDigaRayed aDikaM gaRayet.
'aparigaRitaguRagaRa ISvare' (BA0 pu0 6.9.35). parigaRanaM kArtsnyena gaRanaM kalanaM saMKyAnam.

examples.text: manasvI kAryArTI na gaRayati ca duHKaM
